title: EffectiveConfig
description:
Every configuration leaf with its provenance.

The map is keyed by a dotted path into the configuration document
(`sequences.target_quality.maximum_probes`). A leaf is any non-object value, so a list
is one leaf and replaces as a unit; an object is a section whose keys resolve
individually.

updated_at.description: When the project configuration was last written, in UTC ISO-8601 form.

values.description: Dotted leaf path to its effective value and source.

ResolvedValue.description: One configuration leaf and the level it resolved from.

value.description: The effective value of this leaf.

ValueSource.description:
The uniform error envelope returned by the service.
Where one resolved configuration leaf came from.

oneOf.description: The engine's own default; neither the project nor the video set it.
The project sets it and the video does not override it.
